title: Minimum Flips to Make a OR b Equal to c
description: Calculate minimum bit flips to make (a | b) == c. Given a=2 (010), b=6 (110), c=5 (101).
pseudocode:
1. flips = 0
2. for i from 0 to 31:
3.   bitA = (a >> i) & 1, bitB = (b >> i) & 1, bitC = (c >> i) & 1
4.   if bitC == 0: flips += (bitA + bitB)
5.   else if (bitA | bitB) == 0: flips += 1
6. return flips

steps.note: i=0: a=010(bit 0), b=110(bit 0), c=101(bit 1). bitC is 1, (bitA|bitB) is 0. Flip needed.
i=0: Need 1 flip to change 0 to 1.
i=1: a=010(bit 1), b=110(bit 1), c=101(bit 0). bitC is 0, (bitA=1, bitB=1). Two flips needed.
i=1: flip bitA and bitB to 0. flips = 1 + 2 = 3.
i=2: a=010(bit 0), b=110(bit 1), c=101(bit 1). bitC is 1, (bitA|bitB) is 1. No flip needed.
